name: bosun-agent
description: Bosun agent — enrolls a machine and holds the outbound connection back to the bosun backend

scripts.build:binaries: rm -rf release && mkdir -p release && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 ./src/index.ts --outfile release/bosun-agent-linux-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 ./src/index.ts --outfile release/bosun-agent-linux-arm64 && cd release && shasum -a 256 bosun-agent-* > SHA256SUMS
scripts.release: pnpm build:binaries && gh release create "agent-v$npm_package_version" release/bosun-agent-linux-x64 release/bosun-agent-linux-arm64 release/SHA256SUMS --repo mnik06/bosun --title "agent v$npm_package_version" --notes "Bosun agent binaries"
